Ralph Waldo Emerson on self

Ralph Waldo Emerson (1803–1882) approaches self within Transcendentalism. Self-reliance asks individuals to resist conformity and trust their active relation to the universal. Systematically, the teaching links self-reliance, nature, individuality into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets self most directly—useful for searches such as “ralph waldo emerson quotes on self.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Ralph Waldo Emerson thinker page for biography and to the self theme for other voices on the same question.
